children: Global asset manager Nuveen raised A$705 million ($505.13 million) from Australian institutional investors in an investment that will give them access to the European direct lending market, the company said on Tuesday.
The portfolio will be managed by Nuveen's affiliate, Arcmont.
The investors are superannuation fund Brighter Super, JANA Private Credit Trust and two others.

London-based Arcmont's strategy gives Australian investors access to a portfolio of senior secured, unitranche and subordinated loans to mid- and upper-mid-sized European companies, with a focus on defensive, non-cyclical sectors.

"European direct lending offers compelling diversification potential that is not readily accessible in the domestic market, and we are delighted to be able to offer Australian institutions tailored access to Arcmont's highly regarded platform," said Andrew Kleinig, head of Australia at Nuveen.
